**Indikator 3** is a quality indicator within the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) system. It measures the proportion of adult patients with Crohn's disease who undergo a colonoscopy within one year following an ileocecal resection. This metric is crucial for assessing clinical adherence to the postoperative endoscopic follow-up protocols recommended by international guidelines [^src1].

The indicator was officially introduced into the DANIBD system on October 1, 2022 [^src1]. Its calculation relies on specific procedural codes to identify the relevant patient cohort and their subsequent examinations. The surgical procedures defining the cohort include laparoscopic and open ileocecal resections, as well as right-sided hemicolectomies, tracked via the [[kjfb20-21-30-31|KJFB20/21/30/31]] SKS codes [^src1]. The required follow-up colonoscopies, performed with or without biopsies within a year of the surgery date, are identified using the [[kujf32-35|KUJF32/35]] codes [^src1].

The 2024 DANIBD report marks the first public reporting of Indikator 3, presenting baseline data, calculation rules, and confidence intervals as part of a broader national effort to standardize and improve inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) care [^src1]. During the reporting period, a total of 179 adults with Crohn's disease underwent an ileocecal resection [^src1]. On a national level, 65% of these patients received the recommended endoscopic follow-up on time [^src1]. 

Regional and departmental performances showed significant variation, highlighting both excellent practices and areas needing improvement. Notably, in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], 100% of the patients received the recommended follow-up within the specified timeframe [^src1]. When evaluating individual hospital departments with more than 10 patients, [[ouh-odense-medicinsk-mave-tarm-afd-s|OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S]] was the only department to successfully achieve the established development goal for this indicator [^src1].

## Claims

**Statistical**
- I alt har 179 voksne med Crohns sygdom fået foretaget ileocøkal resektion i opgørelsesperioden [^src1]
- På landsplan har 65 % af patienterne fået den anbefalede opfølgning til tiden [^src1]
- I Region Syddanmark får alle den anbefalede opfølgning til tiden [^src1]
- For afdelinger med flere end 10 patienter er OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S den eneste, som har opnået udviklingsmålet [^src1]
